_comment: Version of record for this STL set; the folder name no longer carries it. Do not edit "version" by hand — run `npx jake bump-set[<set-id>,<version>]`, which writes it here, syncs nuxt-site/server/data/sets.json (freeDownloadUrl included), rebuilds the public zip for a free set, adds the _redirects rule and retires the superseded zip. Editing this file alone leaves the site pointing at a version that was never built; the build scripts refuse to run while the two manifests disagree.
_paidNote: Paid set: never zipped into assets/stls/ (that path is served publicly). Published to R2 by scripts/publish-paid-sets.sh.
